en: A warm tavern and a cold ale. What more could we ask for?
The slain spirit of Lunaclaw stares at you intently, as though wanting something from you.
Spot of tea, gov'na?
Your efforts will prove fruitless. None shall stand in our way!
Wasn't that the night we had to pick up my thumb and carry it in your smoke pouch?

There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.$B$BOne week out of the year during the Spring, the Horde takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.
You were always the troublemaker in the family, Noggle.  Always!
Hail the Lich King!
Greetings young rogue. What do you seek?
Let's move forward!

Now that's a piece of steel worth wearing. Form and function lad/lass, I am impressed. Only ever seen it's match once, a Master in the Great Forge named Grumnus Steelshaper. I bet he has learned a few things since then, could probably teach some to ye.
Remulos, look how easy they fall before me? You can stop this, fool. Turn the druid over to me and it will all be over...
Another student, eh? All right. I'll see what I can do to help you out.
But I do know this - love makes the heart and body weak. It can be exploited. Without your love, I have only my work, Annalise.
Gird yourself, $n, for the demon in this orb is a fel beast.
%s looks around nervously.
I cannot teach you dragonscale leatherworking, $n. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."
I wish to browse your goods, Dirge.
Frostwolf Keep is razed!  We must have supplies in order to repair and rebuild!
Step right up! Finest selection of weapons this side of Ashenvale!
$N, it is time for the final step; we must activate the altar.
You honor us with your presence, my lord.
The end is upon you!
The end is upon you.
NO! Shhhh! Just shut up. Goretooth is coming!
Zul'Farrak - Sergeant Bly - Greeting default.
Nadyia has made quite the leatherworker in her years of practice.  Travel west on the road to Darnassus to pay her a visit and maybe she can bestow some of her knowledge upon you.
You'll keep the bad people away, won't you?
We have barely any supplies.  If we want to send a ground assault into the Field of Strife, then we'll need a lot more!
Yawww!

If Reethe is somehow involved with the burning of the Shady Rest Inn, you'll have to find him and get some answers out of him.$b$bI sent Ogron to track him down. He was headed off to the southeast. Meet up with Ogron and then go find Reethe.
%s lets loose a guttural growl as her body collapses. A horrifying howl can be heard echoing through the halls of Blackrock Spire. Something is very, very angry.
Nuh uh.
%s grumbles.
Oh dear, where is the "Codex of Defense?" Lydros will be most assuredly displeased.
Yes!?
I'll consider that the next time I run into one of these things.

Very fine equipment you make, very fine indeed. Go to the Orc's home of Orgrimmar and seek out a smith named Saru Steelfury. One thing you must give the Orcs, they make beautiful instruments of death.
